data.title: Monetization, corrected after review: core MIT forever; the org view across repositories is $10 per active person a month above a free allowance of 3 repositories and 10 people; first revenue is a flat-fee concierge pilot, not the per-seat price
data.why: A three-way review (plan, code, business) found DEC-62 unworkable in four places. (1) A seat cannot rest on source=agent: actor is the raw git user.email (src/git.ts), so anyone can set KADENCE_SOURCE=agent and never pay, while a bot with its own identity counts as a person. A seat is now every distinct actor email in the org view, case-folded and run through .mailmap and an alias file, minus an explicit bot list and [bot]/noreply addresses, with at least one event first seen on the default branch in the last 30 days. Agents still cost nothing because they write under their human's email. The ULID time is the writer's clock like ts, so the window uses the aggregator's first-seen time. (2) The per-seat pilot charged teams the free allowance keeps free, and its refund rule needed open-tracking we do not have: pilots are a flat fee per organisation ($300-500), success criteria agreed with the buyer before payment, refund on request. (3) No pilot data is processed on our side before the org view exists: the customer runs the report or sends a tarball of .kadence, so no DPA or GDPR processor role until KAD-109. (4) Stripe, Polar and Lemon Squeezy do not pay out to Ukraine; pilots are invoiced through Payoneer, Paddle is kept for the software subscription later.
data.rejected: Seat = distinct human with source=human events: gameable with one environment variable; bots with their own git identity become paying people; Per-seat prepaid pilot ($10 x people x 2 months): bills the very teams the free allowance protects and needs open-tracking to refund; Stripe, Polar or Lemon Squeezy for collection: none pays out to a Ukrainian seller as of 2026-10-15; Hosted processing of pilot journals now: makes a Ukrainian sole proprietor a GDPR processor with no adequacy decision before there is a product to justify it
